# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

2.
prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Identify the test results to be reported through this protocol.

- **Test results to report through this protocol:**
  - 90% and above, refer to Title 15 Vermont Sanitary Code, Sanitary Standards for Public Water Supplies (Table 7.3), for definition of water-quality rule violations. [Note: discussion and photocopied pages are provided at the end of these instructions.]
  - Between 71% and 89%, forward to the CDC for public notification follow-up [CDC protocol phone number: 802-438-7497]
  - Below 70%, forward to the Public Health Action Group for public notification follow-up [PHAB phone number: 802-828-2400]

3. Record and type relevant data from water-quality test lab reports [paper records] or laboratory-report database for tests to be reported
